info.title: Obol API
info.description:
## What is this API?

This API is for creating and managing [Distributed Validators](https://docs.obol.tech/docs/int/key-concepts#distributed-validator). This API works in tandem with Obol's [Distributed Validator Launchpad](https://hoodi.launchpad.obol.org), a dapp designed to allow people to authenticate their counterparties and agree to the terms of a Distributed Validator Cluster. This API will be made more easy for code-only interaction in the coming quarters with the release of the Obol-SDK. 

Read more about Obol and how to use the [launchpad](https://hoodi.launchpad.obol.org) on our [docs site](https://docs.obol.tech/). 

For enquiries:

distributed_validators.description: distributed validator keys and deposit data.

is_not_within_committee.description: Indicates if validator has been active for at least 256 epochs and is not within the committee period

operator_exits.description: An object where the key is an operator address and the value is a number of signed validators.

isTermsAndConditionsSigned.description: Boolean Value Indicating if Terms and Conditions Have Been Signed

amount.description: The amount the recipient is entitled to

index.description: The recipient’s index in the Merkle tree

merkle_proof.description: The Merkle proof (an array of hashes) generated for the recipient

data.description: Nested test categories (`charon_peers`, `beacon_node`, `validator_client`, `mev`, `infra`). Charon signs `JSON.stringify` of this object (after `json.Marshal` in Go); the guard recomputes the hash from the parsed `data` value.

enr.description: ENR text for the Charon node whose private key signed the payload

sig.description: Base64-encoded secp256k1 ECDSA signature (65 bytes: 32-byte r + 32-byte s + 1-byte recovery id) over the SSZ `hashTreeRoot` of the UTF-8 bytes of `JSON.stringify(data)`, matching Charon `publishResultToObolAPI`

partial_public_key.description: Partial public key of the operator

partials.description: Array of partial deposits for this amount

pubkey.description: Full public key of the validator

amounts.description: Array of amounts with their partial deposits

pubkey.description: Public key of the validator (should be in lock file)

amount.description: Amount in Gwei as string (between 1 and 2048 ETH)

pubkeys.description: Optional list of validator pubkeys to filter by. If omitted or empty, returns all validators with registrations.

total_balance_eth.description: Total balance in ETH across all clusters at the specified timestamp (rounded to nearest integer)

total_balance_usd.description: Total balance in USD across all clusters at the specified timestamp (calculated using ETH closing price for that day, rounded to nearest integer)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the data snapshot. All data in this response is for this specific timestamp.

total_unclaimed_balance_eth_denominated.description: Total unclaimed balance in ETH (from daily fees/revenue data for the snapshot date, rounded to 2 decimal places)

total_claimed_balance_eth_denominated.description: Total claimed balance in ETH (from daily fees/revenue data for the snapshot date, rounded to 2 decimal places)

total_eth_transferred.description: Total ETH transferred (from daily fees/revenue data for the snapshot date, rounded to 2 decimal places)

total_revenue.description: Total revenue (from daily fees/revenue data for the snapshot date, rounded to 2 decimal places)

total_fees_eth_denominated.description: Total fees in ETH (from daily fees/revenue data for the snapshot date, rounded to 2 decimal places)

balance_eth.description: Balance in ETH at the snapshot timestamp

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the data snapshot. All data in this response (balances, counts) is for this specific timestamp.

balances.description: Array of validator balances at the snapshot timestamp

total_count.description: Total number of validators at the snapshot timestamp (used for pagination)

total_pages.description: Total number of pages based on the limit parameter and total_count at the snapshot timestamp

additionalAddresses.description: Additional addresses to search (e.g. split addresses from getRelatedSplits, DeFi wrapper WA)

withdrawal_resolved.description: V2: resolved recipients for non-EOA withdrawal addresses

fee_recipient_resolved.description: V2: resolved recipients for non-EOA fee recipients

total_balance_eth.description: Sum of balance_eth for matched validators (latest snapshot)

avg_effectiveness.description: Average effectiveness for matched validators (latest snapshot)

cluster_apr.description: Average APR of affiliated validators (from validator_apy in clusterinformationdetailedv3)

apr.description: Network-wide ETH staking APR as a decimal (e.g. 0.029 = 2.9%). Sourced from Beaconcha.in ethstore/latest.
